data.value: Compatibilidade verificada com o ecossistema Opencode

data.name: Virtual-model names and gateway-owned metadata are rendered directly in the requested client shape.
data.value: Os nomes dos modelos virtuais e os metadados pertencentes ao gateway são renderizados diretamente no formato de cliente solicitado.

data.name: VM NumCtx, Temperature, TopP, TopK, and RepeatPenalty are injected into Ollama options.
data.value: VM NumCtx, Temperature, TopP, TopK e RepeatPenalty são injetados nas options do Ollama.

data.name: VM NumCtx, Temperature, TopP, TopK, and RepeatPenalty hard-override Ollama options.
data.value: Os valores de VM NumCtx, Temperature, TopP, TopK e RepeatPenalty substituem de forma definitiva as options do Ollama.

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, NumPredict, and Thinking override Chat target controls; Chat-only VM thinking is injected through chat_template_kwargs.
data.value: VM Temperature, TopP, NumPredict e Thinking substituem os controles de destino do Chat; o thinking exclusivo do VM do Chat é injetado através de chat_template_kwargs.

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, NumPredict, and Thinking override Chat target fields. Ollama-only DB sampling/context controls do not apply to Chat.
data.value: Os parâmetros VM Temperature, TopP, NumPredict e Thinking substituem os campos de destino do Chat. Os controles de amostragem/contexto do banco de dados exclusivos do Ollama não se aplicam ao Chat.

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, NumPredict, and Thinking override their target fields. Existing nested chat_template_kwargs members are preserved around enable_thinking.
data.value: VM Temperature, TopP, NumPredict e Thinking substituem seus campos de destino. Membros aninhados existentes de chat_template_kwargs são preservados ao redor de enable_thinking.

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, and NumPredict override temperature, top_p, and max_output_tokens. Other nested Responses fields remain untouched.
data.value: VM Temperature, TopP e NumPredict substituem temperature, top_p e max_output_tokens. Os demais campos aninhados de Responses permanecem inalterados.

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, and NumPredict override temperature, top_p, and max_output_tokens. Other VM sampling fields are not applicable.
data.value: VM Temperature, TopP e NumPredict substituem temperature, top_p e max_output_tokens. Outros campos de amostragem do VM não se aplicam.

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, and NumPredict override Responses fields. VM Thinking, TopK, NumCtx, and RepeatPenalty have no Responses target field.
data.value: VM Temperature, TopP e NumPredict substituem os campos do Responses. VM Thinking, TopK, NumCtx e RepeatPenalty não possuem campo de destino no Responses.

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, and NumPredict override Responses target fields. VM Thinking, TopK, NumCtx, and RepeatPenalty are not Responses controls.
data.value: VM Temperature, TopP e NumPredict sobrescrevem os campos de destino do Responses. VM Thinking, TopK, NumCtx e RepeatPenalty não são controles do Responses.

data.name: VM Thinking, NumCtx, Temperature, TopP, TopK, NumPredict, and RepeatPenalty override the request; missing keep_alive uses the Provider value.
data.value: VM Thinking, NumCtx, Temperature, TopP, TopK, NumPredict e RepeatPenalty substituem a solicitação; keep_alive ausente utiliza o valor do Provider.
